name: Women's Class A service dress coat: Honor Guard white ascot (in place of the tie tab; the Honor Guard patch goes on patch_slot) (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-a-coat-female)
size_basis: Not dimensioned beyond "3 1/2 inches below neckband" (CAPR 39-1 9.6.7.8). The cloth fills the open V of garment-blues-class-a-coat-female from the front edge of the neckband to the V's lower point; the front edge dips 1.33 in below the line through the V's top corners with the profile depth = dip x (1 - |u|^2.6), u = -1..1 across the corners, both measured on the four figures (Class A guard, Class A flag bearer, Class B long, Class B short): dip 49.5 / 50 px at 37.4 px/in = 1.32 / 1.34 in, 47.5 / 41 px at 33.4 px/in = 1.42 / 1.23 in. The patch (assets/patches/patch-honor-guard, 3 x 2.938 in, not drawn in this sheet) centres 3.5 in below the corner line. Same box as garment-blues-class-a-coat-female.
provenance: in-house vector. Neck arc scanned column by column on the four figures of "CAP Honor Guard Uniform Guidance" (page 4, 6x render; 29-36 samples each) and fitted as 1 - |u|^2.6 (rms 0.029 of the dip; an ellipse gives 0.092); dip 1.33 in is the mean of the four. V edges: the inner edges of the sheet's lapel-face-right / -left paths (garment-blues-class-a-coat-female: corners 9.82,0.32 and 14.57,0.32 in, lower point 12.15,11.45 in). Patch height: the regulation's 3 1/2 in below the neckband, taken from the corner line (the figures put the patch's centre 3.7 in (Class A, 139 px at 37.4 px/in) and 3.85 in (Class B, 128 px at 33.4 px/in) below it; below the arc's lowest point it would be 2.4 in).
landmarks_note: ascot, neckband_arc, v_left, v_right are polygons / polylines [[x,y]...]; patch_slot is a rect {x,y,w_in,h_in}: where assets/patches/patch-honor-guard is placed (its centre on anchor patch_center); user units (0.01 in); left and right are the viewer's

dimensions.form: white ascot, front edge dipping from the V's top corners
dimensions.layering: draw over the coat body (it covers the sheet's shirt, collar flaps and tie, which need not be hidden) and under the lapel foreground and the lapel insignia; the patch goes over the ascot

documented: white ascot with Honor Guard patch centered 3 1/2 inches below neckband; a white ascot with a center crease (CAPR 39-1 9.6.7.8)
male service cap with Cadet Officer cap device, white ascot with Honor Guard patch ... (9.6.1.2)
